scope: NPC pending held shield break native zero-history and fresh-process inactive cache preservation
input_policy: Existing near-broken NPC shield save unchanged; only body Blend text and public NPC control timing authored. Player normal draw/keyboard unarmed strike. No pose, contact, action, damage or RNG outcomes injected.

expected.zero_model: Preserve all precontact timing fields; calculate native zero offset from weighted/input/offset at frequency1, clear easing and pose, mark inactive. Reset before saved NI5 end.

load_contract.exact: NPC inactive held history/clock; native shield pose, packed velocity, root, identity and reference.
load_contract.derived: World-unit velocity must equal f32(nativePackedLinear*6.999040126800537), angular equals first3 packed angular entries. Redundant derived velocity need not retain its pre-load bit pattern.
